pages.text: The Alchemical Chest is a large storage block with $(l)104 slots$(). It is the base for the $(l:emc_transmutation/alchemical_bags)Alchemical Bags$() and the $(l:emc_generation/condensers)Energy Condenser$().$(br2)$(l)How to get it:$() 3 Covalence Dusts (Low, Medium and High), 2 stone, 1 diamond, 2 iron ingots and 1 wooden chest.$(br2)$(l)Using it:$() right-click to open it. Any item can go in or out, and hoppers and pipes can use any side.

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br2)$(li)The chest ticks the special items stored inside it. A Repair Talisman, a Black Hole Band or a $(l:utilities/gem_of_eternal_density)Gem of Eternal Density$() works while sitting in the chest.$(li)Opening it angers nearby Piglins, just like a vanilla chest.$(li)It holds a small EMC buffer, which lets certain items use it as a target.$(li)It can be waterlogged and does not need to face any particular way.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() none specific.
